g.title: pine
g.text: pine: one namespace, one protocol over it
a place moved, so whoever watched it hears
what happened, written back as a value
a dashed border is an operating-system process of its own. every arrow across one
carries data and nothing else, so neither side can hang or crash the other

g.title: cluster_daemon
g.text: the daemon: one headless image, no display

g.title: cluster_peer
g.text: a peer: another pine, mounted and evaluated in

g.title: cluster_image
g.text: an image: another sbcl, here or on another machine

g.title: tree
g.text: everything addressable is a node, reached by path
a document, and the regions its mode gives it
what is shown where; a split is a write
a widget tree, its role, and whether it is up
what the machine has, and what it will run
what can be run, what is running, what is loaded

g.title: values
g.text: fset in a box, no locks

g.title: systems
g.text: each one a job you can stop

g.title: pa
g.text: one wayland surface per pine surface
layer or toplevel, as the role says

g.title: faults
g.text: the thread stands where it broke
its restarts are what you take

g.title: cli
g.text: the same tree, from a terminal
